description: Package launched by Attal as education minister and carried into his premiership, giving teaching teams the decision on repeating a year and introducing ability grouping in French and mathematics in collèges. Fully applied by about 19% of collèges; the obligation was repealed by a decree published on 12 March 2026, with effect from the 2026 school year.
significance: His signature education reform, and the one his successors undid.

law_name: Nationwide extension of the 15-hour activity requirement for RSA recipients
description: Extension to all departments, from 1 January 2025, of a requirement trialled in eighteen departments, under which recipients of the revenu de solidarité active sign an engagement contract providing for fifteen to twenty hours of weekly activity.
significance: The main welfare-to-work measure announced in his policy declaration to take effect as promised.

description: Trial of a single school outfit in around a hundred schools and some collèges and lycées, state-funded in place of local authorities, intended to lead to nationwide generalisation at the 2026 school year if conclusive. A first official evaluation in May 2026 found mixed results; no generalisation followed and state funding was withdrawn at the end of the trial.
significance: Presented as a symbol of republican equality; discontinued without generalisation.
